title: Task Manager Configuration
description: Configuration for the Task Manager, including options for process sorting and task creation strategies.

activate_extended_scan.description: Enables extended line scanning, typically used for parts with horizontal rollers. Set to true to activate this feature.

process_sorter_name.description:
Specifies the name of the process sorter plugin. Available options include: 
- `FcfsProcessSorter`: Orders processes based on a first-come-first-serve principle, respecting the profile order. 
- `InterleavedProcessSorter`: Interleaves processes from each profile, cycling through them to create a balanced process order.

task_creator_name.description:
Specifies the name of the task creator plugin. Available options include: 
- `DefaultTaskCreator`: Generates scan task tickets for each profile in the sorted process list, and creates preparation subtasks before each process task. All tasks have their `is_dry_run` flag set to false.
